name: V
source:
Occupation: Photographer
Likes: Wines, cacti

The current head of RFA. Prefers using the messenger to communicate with members since Rika's death. Jumin's childhood friend. Mostly offline.

"She's practically on the same boat now that she knows this messenger app..."

V's route is available on Another Story.

[Edited from [url=http://msg.cheritz.com/characters/v]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Kim Jihyun.[/spoiler]
